title: kalimeris alyssoides
intro: Kalimeris alyssoides, commonly known as Chinese Aster or False Aster, is a perennial plant species in the family Asteraceae. It is used in traditional Chinese medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving liver function, and relieving gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of Kalimeris alyssoides are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit anti-inflammatory properties, and display hepatoprotective effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenoids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
